statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail 10 sits in the low band while Stress 45 remains elevated; the published danger window spans 12:30Z-15:00Z.
recommendation: The deterministic mapping holds at EA_ON because the defining overnight observation is a completed retracement rather than a one-way path: the post-earnings spike to 29,654.75 was given back in full to 29,401.75, that marginal new low was rejected, and price has recovered to roughly 29,536 without holding near either extreme. Cross-assets offer no aligned amplifier, with VIX near 14.9 and crude in a fourth consecutive daily decline on Strait of Hormuz diplomacy. The forward path lifts Tail into the WATCH band only for the 13:00Z and 14:00Z hours covering the U.S. cash open and the first full cash hour of Nvidia repricing, and the published danger window is kept narrow at 12:30Z-15:00Z around the claims release and that opening sequence. Stress stays elevated on the hawkish rates backdrop and Friday's Jackson Hole keynote rather than on any observed failure of mean reversion.
headline: Retracement completed and the overnight low rejected: Tail holds at 10, Stress eases to 45 into claims and the Nvidia cash-open repricing
body: Nasdaq-100 September futures trade near 29,536, up roughly 247 points or 0.85%, as of 07:18Z against a previous close of 29,289.50. The structural observation that governs this assessment is unchanged and has strengthened: the impulse that followed Nvidia's results was fully retraced rather than extended. Price reached 29,654.75 after the release, gave back about 253 points to a marginal new overnight low of 29,401.75, and has since recovered roughly 135 points to sit in the upper half of the overnight range without holding near either extreme. That is a two-sided path with a completed retracement, which is the opposite of the persistent no-retracement structure Tail measures, and it keeps the mapped state in the low band. Nvidia reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year, with data-centre revenue of $89.0 billion and third-quarter guidance of about $108 billion, and shares closed the after-hours session up roughly 4.2% following commentary pointing to around 70% revenue growth in fiscal 2028. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed Wednesday at 29,224.52, up 0.05%. Cross-asset context does not supply an amplifier. VIX trades near 14.94, down about 1.8% from a 15.21 close. WTI is near $80.92 and Brent near $86.58, both in a fourth consecutive daily decline as Iran and Oman work through a phased framework for a temporary shipping corridor through the Strait of Hormuz, a de-escalation direction rather than a discontinuity. The most recent H.15 constant-maturity readings place the 2-year at 4.17% and the 10-year at 4.64%. The macro backdrop is the main source of Stress rather than Tail. July PCE published Wednesday showed the headline index up 0.2% on the month and 3.7% year over year, with core up 0.2% and 3.3% year over year, leaving inflation uncomfortably above target while markets price roughly one-in-three odds of a September rate increase. Thursday's own calendar is comparatively light: initial and continuing jobless claims and the advance goods trade balance at 12:30Z, the Kansas City Fed manufacturing survey at 15:00Z, and a 7-year note auction at 17:00Z. The larger scheduled catalyst, Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote, falls on Friday and sits beyond the end of this forecast window. Within the window the single genuine conditional risk is the U.S. cash open at 13:30Z, where a large megacap gap is repriced into index weights; that is the setup most capable of producing opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks, which is why the two cash-open hours are marked at the WATCH boundary and the danger window is confined to 12:30Z-15:00Z. None of that price path is observed at assessment time, and the overnight evidence currently points the other way.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 hours Claude held Tail between 10 and 16 through the Wednesday European and U.S. sessions while Stress climbed from 52 to 61 as the market positioned into July PCE and the Nvidia print. Tail stepped to 21 and status to yellow for the 20:00Z hour containing the earnings release, then decayed steadily through 18, 16, 13, 12, 11 and 10 as the reaction proved two-sided rather than one-way, with Stress unwinding from 66 back to 46. Two hourly slots, 21:00Z on 26 August and 00:00Z on 27 August, have no published assessment and are marked unavailable. The dominant mode moved from normal through event/whipsaw around the release and back to mixed as the overnight retracement completed.
outlookSummary: The forward window holds Tail between 10 and 11 across the remaining European hours on the observation that the post-earnings spike has already been retraced in full and the overnight low was rejected rather than held. It rises to 15 for the hour containing initial jobless claims at 12:30Z and to 20 for the cash-open hour and the first full cash hour, the only stretch mapped to WATCH, because an opening auction repricing a large megacap gap is the setup most capable of producing continuation with shallow pullbacks. That structure is explicitly unobserved and conditional. From 15:00Z the path decays through 16, 14, 13 and 12 as the event stack clears, with a one-point lift for the closing hour to reflect imbalance flow. Overnight values fall to a floor of 9 between the U.S. close and the Asian session, then rebuild slowly to 11 by the final hour as pre-event hedging into Friday's Jackson Hole keynote begins. Stress follows the same shape from 45 up to 58 around the open, down to 39 overnight and back to 47, staying elevated on the hawkish rates backdrop rather than on any observed failure of mean reversion. The keynote itself falls outside this window and will be scored by a later assessment.
